method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Shared decision making and patient reported outcomes in rheumatology: HAQ, PROMIS, PROs
topic.coverageNote: Grounds HAQ, PROMIS, and preferred patient-reported disease-activity measures. It does not describe a shared-decision-making method, so none is taught.

mcqs.question: Which five measures did the 2019 ACR update select as preferred for regular clinical use?

options.A: CDAI, DAS28-ESR/CRP, PAS-II, RAPID3, and SDAI
options.B: HAQ, ESR, CRP, rheumatoid factor, and anti-CCP only
options.D: Sharp score, MRI synovitis, ultrasound, PET, and arthroscopy
options.E: Pain VAS as the only acceptable measure

mcqs.correctAnswerText: CDAI, DAS28-ESR/CRP, PAS-II, RAPID3, and SDAI
mcqs.explanation: Five preferred RA disease-activity measures were selected: CDAI, DAS28-ESR/CRP, PAS-II, RAPID3, and SDAI.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Five preferred RA disease activity measures for regular clinical use were selected: CDAI, DAS28-ESR/CRP, PAS-II, RAPID3, and SDAI.

mcqs.question: Which functional-status instruments does the parallel recommendation name?

options.A: PROMIS Physical Function 10, MD-HAQ, and HAQ-II
options.B: Only the original HAQ, with PROMIS excluded

mcqs.correctAnswerText: PROMIS Physical Function 10, MD-HAQ, and HAQ-II
mcqs.explanation: Functional-status recommendations include PROMIS Physical Function 10, the Multi-Dimensional HAQ, and HAQ-II.

sourceRefs.excerpt: recommendations for the use of PROMIS Physical Function 10, MD-HAQ, and HAQ-II

mcqs.question: Where do the HAQ and the MDHAQ sit inside the preferred disease-activity indices named here?

options.A: PAS contains the HAQ, and RAPID3 contains the MDHAQ
options.B: CDAI is composed only of the HAQ
options.C: SDAI replaces both questionnaires with CRP
options.D: DAS28 contains the full HAQ disability index
options.E: Neither questionnaire is used in any preferred index

mcqs.correctAnswerText: PAS contains the HAQ, and RAPID3 contains the MDHAQ
mcqs.explanation: PAS contains the Health Assessment Questionnaire, and RAPID3 contains the Multi-Dimensional Health Assessment Questionnaire.

sourceRefs.excerpt: PAS contains the Health Assessment Questionnaire ( ) and RAPID3 contains the MultiDimensional Health Assessment Questionnaire (MDHAQ)

mcqs.question: What does the update say about disease-activity scores that include patient-reported measures when fibromyalgia is also present?

options.A: Those scores are higher in patients with comorbid fibromyalgia
options.C: Fibromyalgia does not change any patient-reported score
options.D: Only laboratory-based scores rise, and patient-reported scores fall
options.E: The update says fibromyalgia invalidates the CDAI but not RAPID3

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Those scores are higher in patients with comorbid fibromyalgia
mcqs.explanation: Disease-activity scores that include patient-reported measures are higher in patients with comorbid fibromyalgia.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Disease activity scores including patient reported measures are higher in patients with comorbid fibromyalgia

mcqs.question: What does this update actually recommend a clinician do when putting a measure into routine use?

options.A: Select one preferred measure (CDAI, DAS28, PAS-II, RAPID3, or SDAI), without precluding other measures
options.B: Use every preferred measure at every visit
options.C: Replace disease-activity measurement with a shared-decision checklist that this paper defines
options.E: Use imaging as the only regular measure

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Select one preferred measure (CDAI, DAS28, PAS-II, RAPID3, or SDAI), without precluding other measures
mcqs.explanation: When integrating measurement into the record, the update recommends selecting a preferred measure and does not preclude other RA disease-activity measures. It does not define a shared-decision procedure.

sourceRefs.excerpt: we recommend selecting a preferred RA disease activity measure (CDAI, DAS28, PAS-II, RAPID3, SDAI)
